children: Vivakor Inc. (VIVK) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 04, 2026.

On October 30, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing a proposed hydrogen plant and fueling station at a Texas International Airport. The full text of the press release is attached to this Current Report on Form 8-K as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference in this Item 7.01.

On November 3, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing that it has engaged an international business strategist to assist with the proposed hydrogen plant and fueling station at a Texas International Airport. The full text of the press release is attached to this Current Report on Form 8-K as Exhibit 99.2 and is incorporated herein by reference in this Item 7.01.

On November 4, 2026, the Company issued a press release highlighting a potential acquisition by Direct Midstream, a company Vivakor is in negotiations with to acquire. The full text of the press release is attached to this Current Report on Form 8-K as Exhibit 99.3 and is incorporated herein by reference in this Item 7.01.

The information contained in this Item 7.01 and in the accompanying Exhibits 99.1-99.3 are deemed to be "furnished" and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or incorporated by reference in any filing under the Exchange Act or the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1450704/000182912626011979/vivakorinc_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1450704/000182912626011979/0001829126-26-011979-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
